how: Each flagged row re-run on Google Maps (2026-11-24, one at a time, by its map query; the place's name and address on the page compared with the row), then one web search or the place's own / official tourism page for the reason and a reopening date. Permanently closed on Maps for this place → removed; seasonal or a short closure with a dated source → kept (season note added to 'why' when the row did not already name it); temporarily closed for renovation with no date, or with no reason or reopening date found → removed. No town fell under its minimums, so nothing was added.
